blocked.access: Not established. No source says who owns the ground or whether there is a path; OSM shows no private way within 150 m, which is weak evidence only. Check on the ground; do not publish as walkable without a source.

blocked.verify_notes: Register sheet 04: girth 1000 cm (10 m, possibly a multi-stem mass), height 10 m. OSM node 1506501706 'Carrubo di Contrada Candelaro', local name 'Carrua, A maccia ra carrua', circumference 9 m, height 13, crown 14 x 16.3 m, description 'one of the largest and longest-lived carobs in Sicily'; 35 m from the register point. A 10 m carob is exceptional. No dated sighting, no photo, no iNaturalist record. Recognise: a giant spreading carob, crown 14 to 16 m across, in the Cava Candelaro valley; local name 'a maccia ra carrua'. Register plus OSM only; land tenure unknown.
